reviewType: Independent native-source visual and pixel review
scope: Exact Confederate A SOUTH v14 native four-phase marching source; limited local opt-in preview only
verdict: PASS for exact-source local opt-in SOUTH four-phase march preview, with 2D role and foot-contact limits recorded

appearance.kit: Gray kepi-like cap and worn gray jacket, tan trousers, brown boots, brown crossed shoulder straps, tan upper-back roll/canteen and dark hip pouches appear in all four cells.
appearance.referenceContinuity: Broad kit/palette compared with accepted v14 S actions1 and retained v13 E actions source. Native source is drawn smaller within its cells but uses its own measured height at runtime. Exact face, skeleton and manufactured equipment continuity is not established.

bearingAndGrip.bearing: All four show front cap brim/head/chest, both front shoulder straps, front trouser chains and screen-down toe presentation from an elevated front camera; no cell is native N rear or E/W side profile.
bearingAndGrip.grip: Two separated hands plausibly contact upright weapon stock/fore-end in each phase, with lower grip and upper cross-body grip retained.
bearingAndGrip.limits: Hidden pelvis, thighs under jacket, fingers and contact depth are estimated from2D overlap. No recovered camera calibration, physical anatomy or historically verified drill.

cells.name: TL left contact
cells.observation: TL contact: anatomical LEFT/imageRIGHT full hip-thigh-knee-shin-boot chain leads screen-down; anatomical RIGHT/imageLEFT leg trails shorter behind. Both contact soles are shown, with imageRIGHT leading boot lower in screenY.

cells.name: TR left-support/right passing
cells.observation: TR passing: anatomical LEFT/imageRIGHT full leg is long/planted supporting; anatomical RIGHT/imageLEFT knee/shin flexes with boot raised closer under hip and higher than TL trailing contact. Support belongs to the same leading side as TL, correcting prior attempts.

cells.name: BL right contact
cells.observation: BL opposite contact: anatomical RIGHT/imageLEFT full chain now leads screen-down; anatomical LEFT/imageRIGHT full chain trails shorter behind. The contact leg roles visibly reverse TL.

cells.name: BR right-support/left passing
cells.observation: BR opposite passing: anatomical RIGHT/imageLEFT full leg is long/planted supporting; anatomical LEFT/imageRIGHT knee/shin flexes with boot raised nearer hip and higher than BL trailing contact. Full support/swing roles reverse TR.

poseSequenceReview.method: Fresh all-four-cell full hip-to-thigh-to-knee-to-shin-to-boot visual inspection; role inference uses whole chains and supporting/swing assignment, not isolated boot tips. The two contacts reverse leading legs and the two passing states reverse supporting legs.
poseSequenceReview.geometricReferenceOnly: New colored native S guide used solely to disambiguate intended role/camera; anatomical LEFT=front-view imageRIGHT and anatomical RIGHT=imageLEFT. No roots, cap/sole coordinates, guide scale or guide approval copied.
poseSequenceReview.limits: Contact heel/toe attachment and trailing contact depth remain less clear than support/swing role. Passing lift is modest and under/near hip; four discrete illustrations do not certify a continuous physical gait or zero foot sliding.

measurementContract.coordinateSpace: Native per-cell pixels from cell top-left; TL/TR/BL/BR order. Bounds and supporting sole Y are exclusive.
measurementContract.rootMeaning: Fresh manual concealed pelvis-center X projected to independently visible supporting boot sole Y in each cell; a2D registration pivot, not certified pelvis reconstruction or recovered physical ground.
measurementContract.groundMethod: Fresh visually selected alpha>=64 boot-only ROIs for the leading/supporting imageRIGHT boot in TL/TR and imageLEFT boot in BL/BR; exclusive bottom Y measured separately in every cell. Upright weapon, lifted/trailing boot and torso pixels are excluded.
measurementContract.capMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 minimumY in manually selected cap crown regions; excludes rifle to imageLEFT and back-roll/shoulder pixels.
measurementContract.referenceMethod: Rounded median of four fresh cap-to-individual-supporting-sole spans; one whole-source scale, no per-phase scaling.

nativePixelEvidence.coloredRGBAssessment: Targeted red/yellow samples occur only at alpha1/2/4; no solid red/yellow criterion hits atalpha64. Native viewers overemphasize nearly transparent RGB. This is not exhaustive transparency/fringe certification.

limits: Acceptance binds only to this exactSHA and allfour inspected cells for localoptin preview.
Four discrete native poses are not skeletal/continuous animation or proof of historical marching drill and foot contact.
Contact depth/heel-to-ground assignment, hidden pelvis, fingers and approximate supporting sole remain uncertain.
Native cap-to-supporting-sole spans vary by10pixels; one whole-source height329 retains the variation without per-phase normalization.
Source is drawn smaller in its native627cells than S actions; runtime scale comes from separately measured sourceheight, while final renderer clarity/temporal behavior remains tobe checked.
Low-alpha colored RGB residue remains; targeted alpha criteria do not prove perfectly clean transparency or absence of every fringe color.
Model-assisted review, not human, anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production or complete-family certification.
Runtime phase timing, turns, pause/checkpoint geometry, decoded/GPU/process residency and device performance remain separate checks.
registrationAssessment: Each phase uses fresh individual supporting soleY and manual concealed pelvisX; per-source median scales the complete sheet. Native pixels and layout are unchanged.
